source_review.notes: Reviewed all ten references. Pipeline semantics were checked against Kahn and Lee-Messerschmitt; population reasoning against Little; dependency, bounded-token, ordering, cancellation, executor, asynchronous-copy, and demand behavior against official OpenMP 6.0, oneTBB, Go, Python, NVIDIA CUDA, and Reactive Streams materials. Eight sources resolved directly. The IEEE DOI returned accepted publisher metadata and the INFORMS DOI resolved but denied automated content retrieval, so they support bibliographic and scoped theorem attribution only, not inaccessible quotations.

evidence: Definitions and Notation consistently defines k stages, n items, per-item/stage service s_(i,j), homogeneous s_j, completion C(i,j), latency, bottleneck interval, throughput, makespan, capacities K_e, occupancies Q_e, replicas p_j, and terminal counts.
The recurrence and balanced special-case formula use declared one-server, positive-duration, independent-item domains.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Reviewed indices, maxima, reciprocal units, finite-workload boundaries, queue bounds, and separation of count, byte, time, throughput, and resource utilization.

evidence: artifacts/snippets/CONPAR-048/report.json records stage times 2,3,1; completion rows 2/5/6, 4/8/9, 6/11/12, 8/14/15; latency six; interval three; makespans 15/24; and speedup 1.60.
Exercise 1 independently recomputes first latency 10, bottleneck interval four, six-item pipeline makespan 30, serial makespan 60, and finite speedup 2.0.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Replayed every max-plus recurrence cell and checked sums, intervals, ratios, and the exact printed output.

evidence: C(i,j)=max(C(i,j-1),C(i-1,j))+s_(i,j) follows from previous-stage data readiness and single-server stage availability.
For balanced s_j=s, one item fills k slots and n-1 later items each add one slot, yielding (k+n-1)s versus serial nks; throughput cannot exceed 1/max s_j in the stated ideal model.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The unequal-stage shortcut is explicitly restricted to a deterministic nonblocking line and is not applied to general graphs, finite-buffer blocking, shared resources, or variable items.

evidence: Reviewed one item, short and long streams, balanced/imbalanced stages, tiny transfers, zero useful overlap, variable/heavy work, key skew, batch deadlines, capacity-one/full/empty edges, and bounded reorder gaps.

Reviewed shared CPU/memory/device resources, branch/join registration, feedback, blocking cycles, retries after ambiguous effects, checkpoint versioning, cancellation in every location, closure races, and safety-critical use.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Boundary analysis spans timing, capacity, ownership, order, state, effects, liveness, recovery, topology, and deployment limits.

evidence: Every admitted item has stable identity, one logical owner, contract-valid stage input/output, and exactly one terminal category; all queues, batches, retries, joins, and reorder windows are bounded.

Branch obligations register before publication; ordered effects commit at the declared frontier; cancellation follows identity; termination includes active, queued, in-transit, retrying, joined, reordered, and externally unsettled work.
invariant_checking.notes: Checked invariants across admission, claim, transform, transfer, replicate, batch, branch, join, reorder, retry, effect, cancel, close, drain, and termination.

evidence: The executable recurrence processes each item-stage pair once after both prerequisites and exactly reproduces the declared completion matrix.
Capacity, identity, and terminal conservation obligations prevent unbounded hidden ownership and duplicate logical settlement when correctly implemented.
proof_review.notes: The arguments cover the teaching model and design obligations; no machine-checked proof of a runtime, general Kahn network, distributed pipeline, liveness, or performance is claimed.

evidence: Exact recurrence/balanced formulas are separated from rough replicated capacity p_j/E[s_j] and from measured runtime claims.
Fusion, replication, buffering, batching, routing, gap handling, checkpointing, and heterogeneous placement are presented as contract-dependent engineering choices.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Mathematical results, scoped models, implementation invariants, heuristics, empirical requirements, and human safety review remain distinguishable.

evidence: python3 tools/verify_snippets.py CONPAR-048 passed the deterministic recurrence with recorded interpreter version, exact stdout, empty stderr, and exit code zero.

The chapter requires matched sequential oracles, stream-length/capacity/replica sweeps, service/wait/transfer/tail metrics, resource counters, output equivalence, and controlled faults before runtime claims.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: The sequential arithmetic model proves no concurrent overlap, memory safety, ordering protocol, backpressure liveness, speedup, or deployment safety.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed cross-item overlap, recurrence timing, fill/drain, latency versus throughput, boundaries, stage balance, fusion/replication, bounded buffers, bubbles, variability, batching, ordering, hazards, errors/effects, cancellation, termination, heterogeneous placement, and verification.

practitioner_review.notes: Reviewed typed ownership transfers, finite count/byte budgets, progress-safe backpressure, per-key state routing, bounded reorder and gap policy, branch obligation registration, one retry owner, idempotency/reconciliation, compatible checkpoints, dependency-ordered closure, joined workers, resource counters, and semantic oracles.

pedagogical_review.notes: The review sheet distinguishes latency, interval, throughput, and makespan; exposition progresses from timing model to production lifecycle; the max-plus recurrence is reproducible; ten worked examples cover distinct mechanisms; and five exercises progress from calculation to railway-safety transfer with complete matching answers.

limitations: Internal authoring, source, mathematical, snippet, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external concurrency-theory, language-runtime, operating-system, CPU/GPU, distributed-streaming, performance, medical, railway, regulatory, real-time, or safety review is claimed. The model establishes neither production pipeline correctness nor throughput, latency, ordering, liveness, recovery, or safety.
